method: Exhaustive closure of a relaxed finite state graph, including unlimited one-per-outward-round Calm and free removals; all legal games are a subset. Return cannot retain PoLong because the boat must be empty.
not_claimed: This upper bound is not a full-game reachability or balance test.

memory_proof.reason: Only one active soul per ordinary source, so each source can reward at most once before overflow. 3 held + 1 new = 4. Multiple different sources use different reserves. Spent/discarded cards replenish reserve.
